nC01.text:
C01 Comment tools
Pick a markup or drawing tool from Comment mode’s one toolbar; colour and width apply to the next mark.
States: Shapes menu open (keyboard focus on Arrow); certified file where comments can’t be saved (banner, Save a copy).
Todos: E4f

nC02.text:
C02 Ink and shapes
Draw freehand ink and shapes; a selected shape shows 8 handles and its properties in the inspector.
States: cloudy rectangle selected (stroke, fill, opacity, width, style); ink stroke in progress (Esc cancels, release ends).
Todos: E4d

nC03.text:
C03 Free text and callouts
Type straight onto the page in a text box or a callout with a leader line; the inspector sets font, size, alignment, fill and border.
States: callout being edited (caret in box, knee and arrow handles); empty box shows a placeholder until typed.
Todos: E4e

nC04.text:
C04 Comments panel
Every comment in the file as threads: reply, set status (Accepted, Rejected, Cancelled, Done), filter, search, jump to.
States: thread open with reply box; filter menu open with 3 threads checked for bulk actions. Empty and no-match states in the doc.
Todos: E5b

nC05.text:
C05 Stamps and attachments
Stamp a page from a standard, dynamic (name and date filled in now) or custom image stamp; attach a file to a spot on the page.
States: stamp picker open on Dynamic; attachment selected with Save and Replace.
Todos: E5c

nC06.text:
C06 Import and export comments
Move comments in and out as XFDF or FDF, and export highlights and notes as Markdown.
States: export dialog with Markdown preview; import dialog with match report and one unsupported comment.
Todos: E5d

nC07.text:
C07 Flatten and summary
Burn comments into the page content, or make a new PDF that lists every comment beside its page.
States: flatten on an approval-signed file (signature stays valid, history note, full-rewrite option); summary options with preview.
Todos: E5e

nC08.text:
C08 Phone annotate
Annotate replaces the bottom bar with Pen, Highlighter, Eraser, Note and Done; comments open in a sheet.
States: pen stroke on page with colour row; comment sheet at medium detent with reply field.
Todos: E4f, U3a

nC09.text:
C09 Tablet stylus
The pen draws and the finger scrolls (palm rejection); a docked tool shelf holds pens, widths and colours at 44 px.
States: pressure-varying ink while the palm rests on the screen; Draw with finger off.
Todos: E4f
